# Purpose

This README documents the code and reasoning behind my answers to the 2026 Financial Econometrics practical exam. Write-ups are in Questions/QuestionX; all data folders are git-ignored.

# Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(rmsfuns)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, lubridate, tbl2xts, xts, PerformanceAnalytics, RcppRoll, fmxdat)
```

# Question 1: Exploring Risk and Uncertainty

## Part A

Load the data and source the functions. The suggested datasets from the paper, plus MSCI indexes as the global comparison. Functions are live in the question folder’s code/

```{r Q1A_data}
fmxdat::source_all("Questions/Question1/code")

Uncertainty_Indexes <- "data/Econ_Uncertainty_Indexes.rds" %>% read_rds()
Implied_Vol <- "data/Implied_Vol_Indexes.rds" %>% read_rds()
Idx_Daily <- read_rds("data/Index_Returns_Daily.rds")
Local_Cncy_Vol_Index <- read_rds("data/LCL_Currency_Vol_Index.rds")
Gl_Cncy_Vol_Index <- read_rds("data/Global_Currency_Vol_Index.rds")
Commods <- read_rds("data/Commodities.rds")
MSCI <- read_rds("data/MSCI_Indexes.rds")

# Familiarise: which local indexes do we have, and from when?
Idx_Daily %>% group_by(Tickers, Name) %>%
  summarise(Start = first(date), End = last(date), N = n(), .groups = "drop")
```


Realised volatility, local vs global. Local: Capped SWIX, Top 40, MidCaps, SmallCaps. Global: MSCI ACWI and MSCI EM, with simple returns computed from their total return indexes.

```{r Q1A_realised}
StartDate <- ymd(20150101)

Local_Rets <-
  Idx_Daily %>%
  filter(Tickers %in% c("J433", "J200", "J201", "J202")) %>%
  select(date, Name, Return = Returns)

Global_Rets <-
  MSCI %>%
  filter(Name %in% c("MSCI_ACWI", "MSCI_EM")) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  mutate(Return = TRI / lag(TRI) - 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(date >= StartDate, !is.na(Return)) %>%
  select(date, Name, Return)

Vol_Rets <- bind_rows(Local_Rets, Global_Rets)

# Calendar-year annualised volatility (%)
Vol_Table(Vol_Rets) %>% mutate(across(-Year, ~ round(. * 100, 1)))

Roll_Vol_Plot(Vol_Rets %>% filter(Name %in% c("Capped SWIX", "MSCI_ACWI", "MSCI_EM")),
              Width = 63,
              Title = "Rolling 3-month realised volatility",
              Subtitle = "Local (Capped SWIX, ZAR) vs global (MSCI, USD)")
```

Fear gauges. Implied volatility (VIX, V2X, VXEEM), currency volatility (SAVIUSD for the ZAR, JPMVXYGL globally), global policy uncertainty (EPU) and bond volatility (MOVE), averaged by month. Fixes SAVIUSD values that were recorded divided by 100.


```{r Q1A_fear, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
Local_Cncy_Vol_Index <-
  Local_Cncy_Vol_Index %>%
  mutate(TRI = ifelse(TRI < 1, TRI * 100, TRI))   # data fix: 2021-2026 prints divided by 100

Fear <-
  bind_rows(Implied_Vol,
            Local_Cncy_Vol_Index %>% select(-Description),
            Gl_Cncy_Vol_Index,
            Uncertainty_Indexes %>% filter(Name %in% c("EPUCGLCP", "MOVE_Index"))) %>%
  filter(date >= StartDate) %>%
  mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(Name, YM) %>%
  summarise(date = last(date), Value = mean(TRI, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

g_fear <-
  Fear %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(date, Value, color = Name), linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Global and local fear gauges (monthly averages)", x = "", y = "") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

fmxdat::finplot(g_fear, x.date.type = "%y", x.date.dist = "2 years")

# Yearly averages for the write-up
Fear %>%
  mutate(Year = substr(YM, 1, 4)) %>%
  group_by(Name, Year) %>%
  summarise(Avg = round(mean(Value), 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
  spread(Name, Avg)
```

GARCH conditional volatility. Demeaned log returns (Practical 6). Test for ARCH effects, choose the variant on information criteria, then fit AR(1)-GJR-GARCH(1,1) with a skewed-t distribution to the Capped SWIX and MSCI ACWI.

```{r Q1A_garch}
pacman::p_load(rugarch)

GARCH_Rets <-
  Vol_Rets %>%
  filter(Name %in% c("Capped SWIX", "MSCI_ACWI")) %>%
  mutate(Name = gsub(" ", "_", Name)) %>%      # tbl_xts would otherwise rename to Capped.SWIX
  group_by(Name) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(dlogret = log(1 + Return)) %>%
  mutate(scaledret = dlogret - mean(dlogret, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

xts_GARCH <- GARCH_Rets %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = scaledret, spread_by = Name)

SWIX <- na.omit(xts_GARCH[, "Capped_SWIX"])    # select by NAME: tbl_xts sorts columns alphabetically
ACWI <- na.omit(xts_GARCH[, "MSCI_ACWI"])

# 1. ARCH effects? H0: no autocorrelation in squared returns
Box.test(coredata(SWIX^2), type = "Ljung-Box", lag = 12)
Box.test(coredata(ACWI^2), type = "Ljung-Box", lag = 12)

# 2. Which variant? (lower is better)
GARCH_Compare(SWIX)

# 3. Fit and inspect
Fit_SWIX <- GARCH_Fit(SWIX)
Fit_ACWI <- GARCH_Fit(ACWI)
round(Fit_SWIX@fit$matcoef, 4); persistence(Fit_SWIX)
round(Fit_ACWI@fit$matcoef, 4); persistence(Fit_ACWI)

# 4. Model check: standardised residuals squared should be white noise
Box.test(coredata(residuals(Fit_SWIX, standardize = TRUE)^2), type = "Ljung-Box", lag = 12)

# 5. Conditional volatility: plot, co-movement and yearly averages
Sigmas <- bind_rows(GARCH_Sigma(Fit_SWIX, "Capped SWIX"), GARCH_Sigma(Fit_ACWI, "MSCI ACWI"))

g_garch <-
  Sigmas %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(date, Sigma, color = Name), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "GJR-GARCH(1,1) conditional volatility", x = "", y = "Annualised sigma") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx()

fmxdat::finplot(g_garch, y.pct = TRUE, y.pct_acc = 1)

Sigmas %>% spread(Name, Sigma) %>% na.omit() %>%
  summarise(Correlation = cor(`Capped SWIX`, `MSCI ACWI`))
```


Stratification: does offshore stress raise local volatility? Winsorise returns at 1%/99%, flag the top and bottom 20% of months for VIX, global EPU and Brent oil volatility, and compare each index’s volatility in those months with its full-sample volatility.

```{r Q1A_strat}

Winsor <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  pmin(pmax(x, q[1]), q[2])
}

Idxs <-
  Vol_Rets %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  mutate(Return = Winsor(Return)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m"))

# Monthly stress drivers
VIX_M <- Implied_Vol %>% filter(Name == "VIX", date >= StartDate) %>%
  mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(YearMonth) %>% summarise(Level = mean(TRI))

EPU_M <- Uncertainty_Indexes %>% filter(Name == "EPUCGLCP", date >= StartDate) %>%
  mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(YearMonth) %>% summarise(Level = last(TRI))

Oil_M <- Commods %>% filter(Name == "Oil_Brent", date >= StartDate) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(Ret = TRI / lag(TRI) - 1, YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(YearMonth) %>% summarise(Level = sd(Ret, na.rm = TRUE) * sqrt(252))

Top_Q <- function(df) df %>% filter(Level > quantile(Level, 0.8)) %>% pull(YearMonth)
Bot_Q <- function(df) df %>% filter(Level < quantile(Level, 0.2)) %>% pull(YearMonth)

Strat <-
  bind_rows(
    Perf_comparisons(Idxs, Top_Q(VIX_M), "High VIX"),
    Perf_comparisons(Idxs, Bot_Q(VIX_M), "Low VIX"),
    Perf_comparisons(Idxs, Top_Q(EPU_M), "High Global EPU"),
    Perf_comparisons(Idxs, Bot_Q(EPU_M), "Low Global EPU"),
    Perf_comparisons(Idxs, Top_Q(Oil_M), "High Oil Vol"),
    Perf_comparisons(Idxs, Bot_Q(Oil_M), "Low Oil Vol"))

Strat %>% select(Name, Period, Ratio) %>% mutate(Ratio = round(Ratio, 2)) %>% spread(Name, Ratio)

```





## Part B

Load and clean the data. Holdings, factor scores, index constituents and daily stock returns, with the cleaning decisions listed at the top.

```{r Q1B_data}
fmxdat::source_all("Questions/Question1/code")   # picks up the three new functions

SafeCore <- read_rds("data/SafeCore.rds")
Factor_Scores <- read_rds("data/Factor_Scores.rds")
Local_Index_Constituents <- read_rds("data/Index_Constituents.rds")
Stock_Rets <- read_rds("data/Stock_Returns_Daily.rds") %>% select(date, Tickers, Return = Returns)

# Data errors: daily moves beyond +-50% set to NA (238 observations)
sum(abs(Stock_Rets$Return) > 0.5)
Stock_Rets <- Stock_Rets %>% mutate(Return = ifelse(abs(Return) > 0.5, NA, Return))

# SafeCore: fill missing sectors (Index_Constituents lists PAN and VAL as Resources) and rescale weights to 100%
SafeCore <-
  SafeCore %>%
  mutate(Sector = ifelse(is.na(Sector) & Tickers %in% c("PAN", "VAL"), "Resources", Sector)) %>%
  group_by(date) %>% mutate(Weight = Weight / sum(Weight)) %>% ungroup()
```

SafeCore’s returns and volatility vs the benchmark and a low-volatility alternative.

```{r Q1B_returns}
SC_Wts <- SafeCore %>% filter(date >= ymd(20141231))       # stock returns start 2015
SC_Tickers <- sort(unique(SC_Wts$Tickers))

W_xts <- SC_Wts %>% select(date, Tickers, Weight) %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = Weight, spread_by = Tickers)
W_xts[is.na(W_xts)] <- 0

R_xts <- Stock_Rets %>% filter(Tickers %in% SC_Tickers) %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = Return, spread_by = Tickers)
R_xts[is.na(R_xts)] <- 0
R_xts <- R_xts[, colnames(W_xts)]
if (!all(colnames(R_xts) == colnames(W_xts))) stop("Weight and return columns do not line up")

SC_Port <- rmsfuns::Safe_Return.portfolio(R = R_xts, weights = W_xts, lag_weights = TRUE,
                                          contribution = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, value = 1, geometric = TRUE)

SC_Daily <- SC_Port$returns %>% xts_tbl() %>% setNames(c("date", "Return")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date), Name = "SafeCore")

# Strategy indexes rebuilt from constituents (also backfills Low Vol to Aug 2020)
Strat_Idx <- Index_From_Constituents(Local_Index_Constituents, c("Capped SWIX", "LowVol", "Momentum", "Quality", "Value"))

# Validate the rebuild against the official Low Vol index (2024 onwards)
Strat_Idx %>% filter(Name == "LowVol") %>% select(date, LowVol_Rebuilt = Return) %>%
  inner_join(Idx_Daily %>% filter(Tickers == "STXLVLJ433") %>% select(date, Lvl = Returns), by = "date") %>%
  summarise(Correlation = cor(Lvl, LowVol_Rebuilt), TE = sd(Lvl - LowVol_Rebuilt) * sqrt(252))

Compare_Rets <-
  bind_rows(SC_Daily,
            Idx_Daily %>% filter(Tickers == "J433") %>% select(date, Return = Returns) %>% mutate(Name = "Capped_SWIX"),
            Strat_Idx %>% filter(Name == "LowVol") %>% mutate(Name = "LowVol_Rebuilt")) %>%
  filter(date >= ymd(20150101))

Vol_Table(Compare_Rets) %>% mutate(across(-Year, ~ round(. * 100, 1)))
Roll_Vol_Plot(Compare_Rets, Width = 63, Title = "SafeCore vs benchmark: rolling 3-month volatility")
```


Risk profile and behaviour in stressed periods.

```{r Q1B_risk}
# Since Sep 2020 (common sample with the Low Vol index)
Compare_xts <- Compare_Rets %>% filter(date >= ymd(20200901)) %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = Return, spread_by = Name)

table.AnnualizedReturns(Compare_xts, scale = 252) %>% round(3)
rbind(VaR(Compare_xts, p = 0.95, method = "historical"), VaR(Compare_xts, p = 0.95, method = "modified"),
      ES(Compare_xts,  p = 0.95, method = "historical"), ES(Compare_xts,  p = 0.95, method = "modified"),
      maxDrawdown(Compare_xts)) %>% round(4)

# Full sample vs benchmark
Full_xts <- Compare_Rets %>% filter(Name != "LowVol_Rebuilt") %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = Return, spread_by = Name)
Ra <- Full_xts[, "SafeCore"]; Rb <- Full_xts[, "Capped_SWIX"]

Monthly <-
  Compare_Rets %>% filter(Name != "LowVol_Rebuilt") %>%
  mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(Name, YM) %>% summarise(date = last(date), Return = prod(1 + Return) - 1, .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(-YM) %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = Return, spread_by = Name)

c(Beta        = CAPM.beta(Ra, Rb),
  UpCapture   = UpDownRatios(Monthly[, "SafeCore"], Monthly[, "Capped_SWIX"], method = "Capture", side = "Up"),
  DownCapture = UpDownRatios(Monthly[, "SafeCore"], Monthly[, "Capped_SWIX"], method = "Capture", side = "Down"),
  TE          = TrackingError(Ra, Rb, scale = 252))
table.AnnualizedReturns(Full_xts, scale = 252) %>% round(3)
maxDrawdown(Full_xts)

chart.RollingRegression(Ra, Rb, width = 252, attribute = "Beta",
                        main = "SafeCore: rolling 1-year beta to the Capped SWIX")

# Stratification: high-VIX months (VIX_M, Top_Q, Winsor from Part A)
SC_Idxs <-
  Compare_Rets %>% filter(Name != "LowVol_Rebuilt") %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% mutate(Return = Winsor(Return)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m"))

Perf_comparisons(SC_Idxs, Top_Q(VIX_M), "High VIX")
SC_Idxs %>% filter(YearMonth %in% Top_Q(VIX_M)) %>% group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(Ann_Return_in_High_VIX = mean(Return) * 252)
```

```{r Q1B_sources, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
RC_Sector %>% mutate(across(c(Weight, Risk_Share), ~ round(. * 100, 1)))
```

Factor scores: your own vs the third party’s, and SafeCore’s tilts.

```{r Q1B_factors, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
Own_Scores <- Own_Factor_Scores(Stock_Rets %>% filter(!is.na(Return), date >= ymd(20190101)))

TP_Scores <- Factor_Scores %>% mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  select(YM, Tickers, Factor, Factor_Value) %>% spread(Factor, Factor_Value)

Scores <- inner_join(TP_Scores, Own_Scores, by = c("YM", "Tickers"))

# Do my scores rank stocks like the third party's? (monthly Spearman rank correlation)
Score_Cors <-
  Scores %>% group_by(YM) %>%
  summarise(Mom = cor(Own_Momentum, Momentum, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
            LowVol_vs_VolSens = cor(Own_LowVol, `Volatility Sensitivity`, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
            .groups = "drop")
summary(Score_Cors)

# Weighted factor exposures: SafeCore vs benchmark vs strategy indexes
Month_End_Wts <-
  Local_Index_Constituents %>%
  filter(Index %in% c("Capped SWIX", "LowVol", "Momentum", "Quality", "Value")) %>%
  mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(Index, YM) %>% filter(date == max(date)) %>%
  mutate(Weight = weight / sum(weight)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(Portfolio = Index, YM, Tickers, Weight)

All_Wts <- bind_rows(Month_End_Wts,
                     SafeCore %>% mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m"), Portfolio = "SafeCore") %>%
                       select(Portfolio, YM, Tickers, Weight))

Exposures <-
  All_Wts %>% inner_join(Scores, by = c("YM", "Tickers")) %>%
  gather(Factor, Score, -Portfolio, -YM, -Tickers, -Weight) %>%
  group_by(Portfolio, YM, Factor) %>%
  summarise(Exposure = sum(Weight * Score, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Weight[!is.na(Score)]), .groups = "drop")

# Composite table: average exposure per strategy
Exposures %>% group_by(Portfolio, Factor) %>%
  summarise(Exposure = round(mean(Exposure), 2), .groups = "drop") %>% spread(Portfolio, Exposure)

# SafeCore's active exposure over time
Active <-
  Exposures %>% spread(Portfolio, Exposure) %>%
  mutate(Active = SafeCore - `Capped SWIX`, date = ymd(paste0(YM, "01"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Active))

g_active <-
  Active %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(date, Active, color = Factor), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~Factor) +
  labs(title = "SafeCore active factor exposure vs Capped SWIX", x = "", y = "Active score") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx() + theme(legend.position = "none")

fmxdat::finplot(g_active, x.date.type = "%y", x.date.dist = "1 year")

Active %>% group_by(Factor) %>% summarise(Mean = round(mean(Active), 2), Latest = round(last(Active), 2))
```




## Part C

Market dispersion over time. Capped SWIX constituents from August 2020, with faulty returns removed. Daily weighted and unweighted CSV, smoothed with a 3-month rolling average.

```{r Q1C_csv}
fmxdat::source_all("Questions/Question1/code")

SWIX_Cons <- Local_Index_Constituents %>% filter(Index == "Capped SWIX")
sum(abs(SWIX_Cons$Return) > 0.5)                                         # 6 data errors
SWIX_Cons <- SWIX_Cons %>% mutate(Return = ifelse(abs(Return) > 0.5, NA, Return))

Active_Managers <- read_rds("data/Active_Managers.rds")

CSV <- CSV_Calc(SWIX_Cons)

CSV_Plot <-
  CSV %>% gather(Type, CSV, -date) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>% arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(CSV_Smooth = RcppRoll::roll_mean(CSV, n = 63, fill = NA, align = "right")) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(!is.na(CSV_Smooth))

g_csv <-
  CSV_Plot %>% ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(date, CSV_Smooth, color = Type), linewidth = 0.9) +
  labs(title = "Capped SWIX cross-sectional volatility (dispersion)",
       subtitle = "Daily CSV, 3-month rolling average", x = "", y = "Daily CSV") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx()

fmxdat::finplot(g_csv, y.pct = TRUE, y.pct_acc = 0.1, x.date.type = "%Y", x.date.dist = "1 year")

CSV %>% mutate(Year = format(date, "%Y")) %>% group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(across(c(Weighted, Unweighted), ~ round(mean(.) * 100, 2)))
```


Rolling correlations and peer dispersion, plotted together

```{r Q1C_cor, fig.height = 7}
Month_Ends <-

Peer_Disp <-

fmxdat::finplot(g_alpha, x.date.type = "%Y", x.date.dist = "1 year")

Roll_Cor %>% mutate(Year = format(date, "%Y")) %>% group_by(Year) %>% summarise(Avg_Cor = round(mean(Avg_Cor), 3))
```


Alpha opportunity across macro regimes

```{r Q1C_macro}
Monthly_Driver <- function(df, Nm, FUN = mean) {
  df %>% filter(Name == Nm, date >= ymd(20200901)) %>%
    mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
    group_by(YearMonth) %>% summarise(Level = FUN(TRI))
}

Drivers <- list(
  VIX                 = Monthly_Driver(Implied_Vol, "VIX"),
  `Global EPU`        = Monthly_Driver(Uncertainty_Indexes, "EPUCGLCP", last),
  `MOVE (bond vol)`   = Monthly_Driver(Uncertainty_Indexes, "MOVE_Index"),
  `ZAR vol (SAVIUSD)` = Local_Cncy_Vol_Index %>% mutate(Name = "SAVIUSD") %>% Monthly_Driver("SAVIUSD"),
  `Oil vol`           = Commods %>% filter(Name == "Oil_Brent", date >= ymd(20200801)) %>% arrange(date) %>%
                          mutate(Ret = TRI / lag(TRI) - 1, YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
                          filter(date >= ymd(20200901)) %>% group_by(YearMonth) %>%
                          summarise(Level = sd(Ret, na.rm = TRUE) * sqrt(252)))

# Stratification: measure in high / low regime relative to its average
Strat_C <- map2_df(Drivers, names(Drivers), ~ Regime_Means(Measures, .x, .y))
Strat_C %>% mutate(across(c(High, Low), ~ round(., 2))) %>% arrange(Measure)

# Supporting evidence: monthly correlations
map2_df(Drivers, names(Drivers), ~
          Measures %>% left_join(.x, by = "YearMonth") %>%
          group_by(Measure) %>% summarise(Cor = cor(Value, Level, use = "complete.obs")) %>%
          mutate(Driver = .y)) %>%
  spread(Driver, Cor) %>% mutate(across(-Measure, ~ round(., 2)))
```


DCC correlations between super-sectors, following the Topic 6 slide.

```{r Q1C_dcc}
pacman::p_load(rmgarch)

Sector_Rets <-
  SWIX_Cons %>% filter(!is.na(Return)) %>%
  group_by(date, SuperSector) %>%
  summarise(Return = sum(weight * Return) / sum(weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SuperSector) %>%
  mutate(dlogret = log(1 + Return), scaledret = dlogret - mean(dlogret)) %>% ungroup()

Sector_xts <- Sector_Rets %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = scaledret, spread_by = SuperSector)  # Financials, Industrials, Resources

garch11.spec <- ugarchspec(mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0)),
                           variance.model = list(garchOrder = c(1, 1), model = "sGARCH"),
                           distribution.model = "norm")

dcc.garch11.spec <- dccspec(uspec = multispec(replicate(3, garch11.spec)),
                            dccOrder = c(1, 1), distribution = "mvnorm")

dcc.fit <- dccfit(dcc.garch11.spec, data = Sector_xts)

Rhot <- rcor(dcc.fit)                       # 3 x 3 x T array
DCC_Cors <- tibble(date = as.Date(index(Sector_xts)),
                   `Financials-Industrials` = Rhot[1, 2, ],
                   `Financials-Resources`   = Rhot[1, 3, ],
                   `Industrials-Resources`  = Rhot[2, 3, ])

g_dcc <-

fmxdat::finplot(g_dcc)
```

# Question 2: Mid, Small and Large Cap Indices

Load and prepare the data. Monthly size-index weights, daily stock returns (faulty moves above ±50% removed), sectors filled in, weights rescaled to 100%.


```{r Q2_data}
fmxdat::source_all("Questions/Question2/code")
pacman::p_load(rugarch)

Size_Idx <- read_rds("data/Monthly_Index_Constituents.rds")
Stock_Rets <- read_rds("data/Stock_Returns_Daily.rds") %>%
  select(date, Tickers, Return = Returns) %>%
  mutate(Return = ifelse(abs(Return) > 0.5, NA, Return))
Idx_Daily <- read_rds("data/Index_Returns_Daily.rds")
Local_Index_Constituents <- read_rds("data/Index_Constituents.rds")
SafeCore <- read_rds("data/SafeCore.rds")
Hedge <- read_rds("data/Currency_Hedge_Plays.rds")
Implied_Vol <- read_rds("data/Implied_Vol_Indexes.rds")
Local_Cncy_Vol_Index <- read_rds("data/LCL_Currency_Vol_Index.rds") %>%
  mutate(TRI = ifelse(TRI < 1, TRI * 100, TRI))

Size_Idx <-
  Fill_Sectors(Size_Idx, Local_Index_Constituents, SafeCore) %>%
  group_by(Fund, date) %>% mutate(Weight = Weight / sum(Weight)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Fund = recode(Fund, CappedSWIX = "Capped SWIX", LargeCaps = "Large Caps",
                       MidCaps = "Mid Caps", SmallCaps = "Small Caps"))

# How much weight is still unclassified (average per month since 2015)?
Size_Idx %>% filter(date >= ymd(20150101)) %>% group_by(Fund) %>%
  summarise(Unclassified = sum(Weight[Sector == "Unclassified"]) / n_distinct(date))
```

Index returns and their risk–return profile. Rebuilt from constituents, checked against the official indexes, then summarised from 2015.

```{r Q2_returns}
StartDate <- ymd(20141231)
Size_Rets <- Size_Index_Returns(Size_Idx, Stock_Rets, StartDate)

# Validate against official indexes: J433 Capped SWIX, J200 Top 40, J201 Mid, J202 Small
Size_Rets %>% spread(Name, Return) %>%
  inner_join(Idx_Daily %>% filter(Tickers %in% c("J433", "J200", "J201", "J202")) %>%
               select(date, Tickers, Returns) %>% spread(Tickers, Returns), by = "date") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  summarise(SWIX = cor(`Capped SWIX`, J433), Large = cor(`Large Caps`, J200),
            Mid = cor(`Mid Caps`, J201), Small = cor(`Small Caps`, J202))

Size_xts <- Size_Rets %>% mutate(Name = gsub(" ", "_", Name)) %>%
  tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = Return, spread_by = Name)

table.AnnualizedReturns(Size_xts, scale = 252) %>% round(3)
rbind(VaR(Size_xts, p = 0.95, method = "historical"),
      ES(Size_xts, p = 0.95, method = "modified"),
      maxDrawdown(Size_xts)) %>% round(4)

g_cum <-
  Size_Rets %>% group_by(Name) %>% arrange(date) %>% mutate(Cum = cumprod(1 + Return)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  ggplot() + geom_line(aes(date, Cum, color = Name), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Cumulative returns of the size indexes", x = "", y = "Growth of R1") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx()
fmxdat::finplot(g_cum)
```


Sector exposure and rand exposure.

```{r Q2_sectors, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
Sector_Exp %>% filter(date %in% c(ymd(20151231), ymd(20200131), ymd(20260831))) %>%
```

Realised volatility: indexes, constituents and GARCH

```{r Q2_vol}
Vol_Table(Size_Rets) %>% mutate(across(-Year, ~ round(. * 100, 1)))
Roll_Vol_Plot(Size_Rets, Width = 63, Title = "Rolling 3-month realised volatility")

# Constituent volatility vs index volatility each December (trailing year)
Dec_Dates <- Size_Idx %>% distinct(date) %>%
  filter(date >= ymd(20151231), format(date, "%m") == "12" | date == max(date)) %>% pull(date)
CV <- map_df(Dec_Dates, ~ Constituent_Vol(.x, Size_Idx, Stock_Rets, Size_Rets))
CV %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))

# GJR-GARCH(1,1) per index
xts_G <- Size_Rets %>% mutate(Name = gsub(" ", "_", Name)) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% mutate(scaledret = log(1 + Return) - mean(log(1 + Return))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = scaledret, spread_by = Name)

GARCH_Coefs <- list()
Sig <- map_df(colnames(xts_G), function(nm) {
  fit <- GARCH_Fit(na.omit(xts_G[, nm]))
  GARCH_Coefs[[nm]] <<- c(coef(fit)[c("alpha1", "beta1", "gamma1")], Persistence = persistence(fit))
  GARCH_Sigma(fit, gsub("_", " ", nm))
})
do.call(rbind, GARCH_Coefs) %>% round(3)

g_sig <- Sig %>% ggplot() + geom_line(aes(date, Sigma, color = Name), linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "GJR-GARCH(1,1) conditional volatility", x = "", y = "Annualised sigma") + fmxdat::theme_fmx()
fmxdat::finplot(g_sig, y.pct = TRUE)
```

Stratification: how the size indexes behave in stressed regimes.

```{r Q2_strat}
Winsor <- function(x) { q <- quantile(x, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE); pmin(pmax(x, q[1]), q[2]) }

Idxs <- Size_Rets %>% group_by(Name) %>% mutate(Return = Winsor(Return)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m"))

Monthly_Lvl <- function(df, Nm) df %>% filter(Name == Nm, date >= ymd(20150101)) %>%
  mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>% group_by(YearMonth) %>% summarise(Level = mean(TRI))

ZAR_M <- Local_Cncy_Vol_Index %>% mutate(Name = "SAVIUSD") %>% Monthly_Lvl("SAVIUSD")
VIX_M <- Monthly_Lvl(Implied_Vol, "VIX")
SWIXVol_M <- Size_Rets %>% filter(Name == "Capped SWIX") %>% mutate(YearMonth = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(YearMonth) %>% summarise(Level = sd(Return) * sqrt(252))

Top_Q <- function(df) df %>% filter(Level > quantile(Level, 0.8)) %>% pull(YearMonth)
Bot_Q <- function(df) df %>% filter(Level < quantile(Level, 0.2)) %>% pull(YearMonth)

Strat <- bind_rows(
  Strat_Perf(Idxs, Top_Q(ZAR_M), "High ZAR vol"),       Strat_Perf(Idxs, Bot_Q(ZAR_M), "Low ZAR vol"),
  Strat_Perf(Idxs, Top_Q(VIX_M), "High VIX"),           Strat_Perf(Idxs, Bot_Q(VIX_M), "Low VIX"),
  Strat_Perf(Idxs, Top_Q(SWIXVol_M), "High local vol"), Strat_Perf(Idxs, Bot_Q(SWIXVol_M), "Low local vol"))

Strat %>% select(Period, Name, Ret, SD_Ratio) %>%
  mutate(Ret = round(Ret * 100, 1), SD_Ratio = round(SD_Ratio, 2)) %>%
  gather(Stat, Value, Ret, SD_Ratio) %>% unite(Col, Name, Stat) %>% spread(Col, Value)
```




# Question 3: Portfolio Return Comparison

Load the data and build the monthly benchmark. Daily Capped SWIX returns compounded to calendar month-ends, so they line up with the peer and ABC data.

```{r Q3_data}
fmxdat::source_all("Questions/Question3/code")

Active_Manager_Peers <- read_rds("data/Active_Managers.rds") %>% rename(Return = Returns)
ABC_Fund <- read_rds("data/ABC_Fund.rds") %>% rename(Return = Returns)
Idx_Daily <- read_rds("data/Index_Returns_Daily.rds")
Size_Idx <- read_rds("data/Monthly_Index_Constituents.rds")
Stock_Rets <- read_rds("data/Stock_Returns_Daily.rds") %>%
  select(date, Tickers, Return = Returns) %>%
  mutate(Return = ifelse(abs(Return) > 0.5, NA, Return))

Bench_M <-
  Idx_Daily %>% filter(Tickers == "J433") %>%
  mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  group_by(YM) %>% summarise(Return = prod(1 + Returns) - 1, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(date = ceiling_date(ymd(paste0(YM, "01")), "month") - days(1)) %>%
  select(date, Return)

Funds <- bind_rows(Active_Manager_Peers, ABC_Fund) %>%
  mutate(Type = ifelse(Name == "ABC_Fund", "ABC Fund", "Peers"))
Peer_Med <- Active_Manager_Peers %>% group_by(date) %>% summarise(PeerMed = median(Return))
```


How high is active managers’ beta? Rolling 3-year beta, R² and alpha. The chart overlays boxplots on a scatter of every peer’s beta each December, with ABC in red.


```{r Q3_beta}
RB <- Roll_Beta(Funds %>% select(date, Name, Return), Bench_M, Window = 36) %>%
  mutate(Type = ifelse(Name == "ABC_Fund", "ABC Fund", "Peers"))

RB %>% group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(Median_Beta = median(Beta), Median_R2 = median(R2), Median_Alpha = median(Alpha), Funds = n_distinct(Name))

RB %>% filter(Type == "Peers") %>% summarise(Share_Beta_above_0.8 = mean(Beta > 0.8), Share_R2_above_0.8 = mean(R2 > 0.8))

# ABC's percentile among peers each December (low = less market-driven)
RB %>% filter(month(date) == 12 | date == max(date)) %>%
  group_by(date) %>% mutate(Beta_Pct = percent_rank(Beta), R2_Pct = percent_rank(R2)) %>%
  filter(Type == "ABC Fund") %>% select(date, Beta, Beta_Pct, R2, R2_Pct)

g_beta <-
  RB %>% filter(month(date) == 12 | date == max(date)) %>% mutate(Year = factor(year(date))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Year, Beta)) +
  geom_jitter(data = . %>% filter(Type == "Peers"), color = "grey60", alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(data = . %>% filter(Type == "Peers"), fill = NA, outlier.shape = NA, color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(Type == "ABC Fund"), color = "red", size = 4, shape = 18) +
  labs(title = "Rolling 3-year beta to the Capped SWIX",
       subtitle = "Peers (grey dots, boxplot) vs ABC Fund (red)", x = "", y = "Beta") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx()
g_beta
```


Does ABC have different return drivers? PCA on the peer correlation matrix (Topic 3), how much of each fund’s return the industry factor explains, plus correlation with the median peer and tracking error.

```{r Q3_drivers}
PCA_Panel <-
  Active_Manager_Peers %>% filter(date >= ymd(20150131)) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% filter(n() == max(table(Active_Manager_Peers$date[Active_Manager_Peers$date >= ymd(20150131)]) * 0 + 130)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% spread(Name, Return)

pca <- prcomp(PCA_Panel %>% select(-date), scale. = TRUE)     # scale = correlation matrix
summary(pca)$importance[, 1:5]

PC <- tibble(date = PCA_Panel$date, PC1 = pca$x[, 1])

Funds_PC <-
  Funds %>% inner_join(PC, by = "date") %>%
  group_by(Name, Type) %>% filter(n() >= 60) %>%
  summarise(R2_PC1 = cor(Return, PC1)^2, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Pct = percent_rank(R2_PC1))
Funds_PC %>% group_by(Type) %>% summarise(Median_R2_PC1 = median(R2_PC1))
Funds_PC %>% filter(Type == "ABC Fund")

Cor_Peer <-
  Funds %>% filter(date >= ymd(20150131)) %>%
  inner_join(Peer_Med, by = "date") %>% inner_join(Bench_M %>% rename(BM = Return), by = "date") %>%
  group_by(Name, Type) %>% filter(n() >= 60) %>%
  summarise(Cor_Peer = cor(Return, PeerMed), Cor_BM = cor(Return, BM), TE = sd(Return - BM) * sqrt(12), .groups = "drop")
Cor_Peer %>% group_by(Type) %>% summarise(across(c(Cor_Peer, Cor_BM, TE), median))
Cor_Peer %>% mutate(Pct_Cor_Peer = percent_rank(Cor_Peer), Pct_TE = percent_rank(TE)) %>% filter(Type == "ABC Fund")
```


Relative performance over time. Peer bands of rolling 12-month returns with ABC on top, ABC’s percentile rank, and the record since 2015 against the median peer and the benchmark.


```{r Q3_relative}
RR <- Roll_Returns_M(Funds %>% select(date, Name, Return), 12)

Bands <-
  RR %>% filter(Name != "ABC_Fund") %>% group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(q05 = quantile(RollRet, .05), q25 = quantile(RollRet, .25), q50 = median(RollRet),
            q75 = quantile(RollRet, .75), q95 = quantile(RollRet, .95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(RR %>% filter(Name == "ABC_Fund") %>% select(date, ABC = RollRet), by = "date")

Rank <-
  RR %>% group_by(date) %>% filter(any(Name == "ABC_Fund")) %>%
  mutate(Pct = percent_rank(RollRet)) %>% filter(Name == "ABC_Fund") %>% ungroup()
Rank %>% summarise(Avg_Percentile = mean(Pct), Top_Quartile = mean(Pct > 0.75),
                   Top_Half = mean(Pct > 0.5), Bottom_Quartile = mean(Pct < 0.25), Latest = dplyr::last(Pct))

g_bands <-
  Bands %>% ggplot(aes(date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95), fill = "grey85") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), fill = "grey65") +
  geom_line(aes(y = q50), color = "grey30", linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ABC), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Rolling 12-month return: ABC Fund vs peer range",
       subtitle = "Light band: 5th-95th percentile; dark band: 25th-75th; dashed: median peer", x = "", y = "") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx()
fmxdat::finplot(g_bands, y.pct = TRUE)

Track <- Funds %>% filter(Name == "ABC_Fund", date >= ymd(20150131)) %>% select(date, ABC = Return) %>%
  inner_join(Peer_Med, by = "date") %>% inner_join(Bench_M %>% rename(BM = Return), by = "date")
Track %>% summarise(across(c(ABC, PeerMed, BM), ~ prod(1 + .)^(12 / n()) - 1))   # annualised return
Track %>% summarise(across(c(ABC, PeerMed, BM), ~ sd(.) * sqrt(12)))             # annualised volatility
```


Does high market dispersion reward ABC? Testing the manager’s claim month by month, over 12-month windows, and in up and down markets.

```{r Q3_dispersion}
CSV_M <- Monthly_CSV(Size_Idx, Stock_Rets)

D <- Track %>% mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>%
  inner_join(CSV_M %>% select(YM, CSV), by = "YM") %>%
  mutate(Regime = case_when(CSV >= quantile(CSV, 0.8) ~ "High dispersion",
                            CSV <= quantile(CSV, 0.2) ~ "Low dispersion", TRUE ~ "Normal"))

# 1. Month by month
D %>% group_by(Regime) %>%
  summarise(Months = n(), ABC_vs_Peer = mean(ABC - PeerMed) * 12, Hit_Rate = mean(ABC > PeerMed))

# 2. Over rolling 12-month windows
R12 <- D %>% arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(Rel12 = RcppRoll::roll_sum(ABC - PeerMed, 12, fill = NA, align = "right"),
         CSV12 = RcppRoll::roll_mean(CSV, 12, fill = NA, align = "right")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rel12))
R12 %>% mutate(Reg = case_when(CSV12 >= quantile(CSV12, 0.8) ~ "High", CSV12 <= quantile(CSV12, 0.2) ~ "Low", TRUE ~ "Normal")) %>%
  group_by(Reg) %>% summarise(Windows = n(), Share_Beating_Peer = mean(Rel12 > 0), Avg_Rel12 = mean(Rel12))
R12 %>% summarise(Share_Beating_Peer = mean(Rel12 > 0), Correlation = cor(Rel12, CSV12))

g_disp <- R12 %>% ggplot(aes(CSV12, Rel12)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Market dispersion and ABC's edge over the median peer (12-month windows)",
       x = "Average market dispersion", y = "ABC minus median peer") + fmxdat::theme_fmx()
g_disp

# 3. Up vs down market months
D %>% mutate(Market = ifelse(BM < 0, "Down month", "Up month")) %>% group_by(Market) %>%
  summarise(Months = n(), ABC_vs_BM = mean(ABC - BM) * 12, ABC_vs_Peer = mean(ABC - PeerMed) * 12,
            Hit_Rate = mean(ABC > PeerMed))
```


# Question 4: Portfolio Construction

```{r Q4.0 setup}
library(rmsfuns)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, lubridate, tbl2xts, xts, PerformanceAnalytics, fmxdat, quadprog, Matrix)
fmxdat::source_all("Questions/Question4/code")

MSCI <- read_rds("data/MSCI_Indexes.rds")
Bond_Yields <- read_rds("data/Global_Bond_Yields.rds")
Commods <- read_rds("data/Commodities.rds")
LCL_Yield_Proxies <- read_rds("data/Monthly_LCL_Yield_Indexes.rds")
Idx_Daily <- read_rds("data/Index_Returns_Daily.rds")
```

```{r Q4.1 monthly returns}
Global_Eq <- Monthly_From_TRI(MSCI %>% filter(Name %in% c("MSCI_USA", "MSCI_EU", "MSCI_Jap", "MSCI_EM")))
Global_Bonds <- Bond_TRI(Bond_Yields %>% filter(Name %in% c("US_10Yr", "Germany_10Yr", "UK_10Yr")))
Commod_M <- Monthly_From_TRI(Commods %>% filter(Name %in% c("Bcom_Index", "Gold")))

Local_Eq <- Idx_Daily %>%
  filter(Tickers %in% c("J200", "J201", "STXMOMJ433", "STXVALJ433", "STXLVLJ433")) %>%
  mutate(Name = recode(Tickers, J200 = "SA_Large", J201 = "SA_Mid", STXMOMJ433 = "SA_Momentum",
                       STXVALJ433 = "SA_Value", STXLVLJ433 = "SA_LowVol")) %>%
  mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%m")) %>% group_by(Name, YM) %>%
  summarise(date = max(date), Return = prod(1 + Returns) - 1, n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% filter(!(row_number() == 1 & n < 15)) %>% ungroup() %>%   # drop partial first month
  select(date, Name, Return)

Local_Yield <- LCL_Yield_Proxies %>%
  mutate(Name = recode(Tickers, ALBITR = "SA_Bonds", CILITR = "SA_ILB", J253 = "SA_Property")) %>%
  select(date, Name, Return = Returns)

Rets_M <- bind_rows(Global_Eq, Global_Bonds, Commod_M, Local_Eq, Local_Yield) %>%
  mutate(date = ceiling_date(date, "month") - days(1)) %>%     # align to calendar month-ends
  filter(date >= ymd(20100131), date <= ymd(20260930))
```

```{r Q4.2 asset info}
Info <- tribble(
  ~Name,          ~Class,      ~Region,
  "MSCI_USA",     "Equity",    "Global",
  "MSCI_EU",      "Equity",    "Global",
  "MSCI_Jap",     "Equity",    "Global",
  "MSCI_EM",      "Equity",    "Global",
  "US_10Yr",      "Bonds",     "Global",
  "Germany_10Yr", "Bonds",     "Global",
  "UK_10Yr",      "Bonds",     "Global",
  "Bcom_Index",   "Commodity", "Global",
  "Gold",         "Commodity", "Global",
  "SA_Large",     "Equity",    "Local",
  "SA_Mid",       "Equity",    "Local",
  "SA_Momentum",  "Equity",    "Local",
  "SA_Value",     "Equity",    "Local",
  "SA_LowVol",    "Equity",    "Local",
  "SA_Property",  "Equity",    "Local",
  "SA_Bonds",     "Bonds",     "Local",
  "SA_ILB",       "Bonds",     "Local")

Rets_M %>% group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(Start = min(date), Months = n(),
            Ann_Ret = prod(1 + Return)^(12 / n()) - 1, Ann_Vol = sd(Return) * sqrt(12)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Ann_Ret, Ann_Vol), ~ round(., 3)))
```

```{r Q4.3 optimise}
# Quarterly rebalancing from end-2019 (gives a 10-year look-back from 2010)
Reb_Dates <- Rets_M %>% distinct(date) %>%
  filter(month(date) %in% c(3, 6, 9, 12), date >= ymd(20191231), date < max(date)) %>% pull(date)

W_MinVol  <- map_df(Reb_Dates, ~ Optim_Weights(.x, Rets_M, Info, Type = "MinVol"))
W_MeanVar <- map_df(Reb_Dates, ~ Optim_Weights(.x, Rets_M, Info, Type = "MeanVar"))

Static <- tribble(~Name, ~Weight,
  "SA_Large", 0.20, "SA_Mid", 0.10, "SA_Property", 0.05,
  "MSCI_USA", 0.13, "MSCI_EU", 0.06, "MSCI_Jap", 0.02, "MSCI_EM", 0.04,
  "SA_Bonds", 0.12, "SA_ILB", 0.03, "US_10Yr", 0.05, "Germany_10Yr", 0.03, "UK_10Yr", 0.02,
  "Gold", 0.08, "Bcom_Index", 0.07)
W_Static <- map_df(Reb_Dates, ~ Static %>% mutate(date = .x))
```

```{r Q4.4 check limits}
bind_rows(Check_Limits(W_MinVol, Info) %>% mutate(Port = "Min Volatility"),
          Check_Limits(W_MeanVar, Info) %>% mutate(Port = "Mean-Variance"),
          Check_Limits(W_Static, Info) %>% mutate(Port = "Static Balanced")) %>%
  group_by(Port) %>% summarise(across(-date, max))

W_MinVol %>% filter(date == max(date), Weight > 0) %>% arrange(-Weight)
W_MeanVar %>% filter(date == max(date), Weight > 0) %>% arrange(-Weight)
```

```{r Q4.5 weights plot}
g <- bind_rows(W_MinVol %>% mutate(Port = "Min Volatility"), W_MeanVar %>% mutate(Port = "Mean-Variance")) %>%
  left_join(Info, by = "Name") %>% mutate(Group = paste(Region, Class)) %>%
  group_by(Port, date, Group) %>% summarise(Weight = sum(Weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot() + geom_area(aes(date, Weight, fill = Group)) +
  facet_wrap(~Port, ncol = 1) + fmxdat::theme_fmx() +
  labs(title = "Weights by region and asset class", x = "", y = "")
fmxdat::finplot(g, y.pct = TRUE)
```

```{r Q4.6 backtest}
P1 <- Port_Return(W_MinVol, Rets_M, "Min Volatility")
P2 <- Port_Return(W_MeanVar, Rets_M, "Mean-Variance")
P3 <- Port_Return(W_Static, Rets_M, "Static Balanced")
Ports <- bind_rows(P1$Ret, P2$Ret, P3$Ret)

Ports_xts <- Ports %>% mutate(Name = gsub(" |-", "_", Name)) %>% tbl_xts(cols_to_xts = Return, spread_by = Name)
round(rbind(table.AnnualizedReturns(Ports_xts, scale = 12),
            `Max DD` = maxDrawdown(Ports_xts),
            `Mod ES 95` = ES(Ports_xts, p = .95, method = "modified")), 3)

g <- Ports %>% group_by(Name) %>% arrange(date) %>% mutate(Cum = cumprod(1 + Return)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  ggplot() + geom_line(aes(date, Cum, color = Name), linewidth = 0.9) + fmxdat::theme_fmx() +
  labs(title = "Cumulative returns", x = "", y = "Growth of R1")
fmxdat::finplot(g)
```

```{r Q4.7 drift, turnover, risk}
# Drift between rebalances (beginning-of-period weights)
P1$BOP %>% xts_tbl() %>% gather(Name, W, -date) %>% left_join(Info, by = "Name") %>%
  group_by(date) %>% summarise(Global = sum(W[Region == "Global"]), Bonds = sum(W[Class == "Bonds"]), Max = max(W)) %>%
  summarise(across(-date, max))

# Average one-way turnover per rebalance
TO <- function(W) W %>% complete(date, Name, fill = list(Weight = 0)) %>% group_by(Name) %>% arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(d = abs(Weight - lag(Weight))) %>% group_by(date) %>% summarise(T = sum(d, na.rm = TRUE) / 2) %>%
  summarise(Turnover = mean(T[-1])) %>% pull()
c(MinVol = TO(W_MinVol), MeanVar = TO(W_MeanVar))

# Risk contribution by asset class at the last rebalance
bind_rows(Risk_Contrib(W_MinVol, Rets_M, Info, max(Reb_Dates), "Min Volatility"),
          Risk_Contrib(W_MeanVar, Rets_M, Info, max(Reb_Dates), "Mean-Variance"),
          Risk_Contrib(W_Static, Rets_M, Info, max(Reb_Dates), "Static Balanced")) %>%
  group_by(Port, Class) %>% summarise(Weight = sum(Weight), Risk = sum(Risk_Share), .groups = "drop")
```
